theorems.label: dominating-set-order-sh
theorems.statement: SH is equivalent to the following exclusion: for every fixed 0 < ε < 1, no deterministic Dominating Set algorithm runs in 2^(O(n^(1−ε))) B^(O(1)) time, where n counts vertices and B is the complete binary input length.

title: Dominating Set by number of vertices is equivalent to the Satisfiability Hypothesis
